# Outreach Recruitment
> Malta's leading recruitment agency connecting EU candidates with jobs in Malta and across Europe.

## About
Outreach Recruitment is a Malta-based recruitment agency that connects employers with qualified EU candidates across various sectors. We provide end-to-end recruitment support including candidate sourcing, CV screening, interview coordination, and visa assistance.

Email: hr@outreachrecruitment.net
Website: https://outreachrecruitment.net
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/outreach-recruitment-agency/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/outreachrecruit/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/outreachrecruitment_agency

## Services
- Job placement in Malta and Europe for EU candidates
- Recruitment and talent sourcing for employers in Malta
- CV screening and candidate shortlisting
- Visa and relocation support for international candidates
- Study in Malta consultation and university program guidance
- Career advice and job application support
